༅ btsu༅7/ /byugs las rgyun shes/ hūṃ dang ༄ / / ngadzi 0 4 'u/ gu thar dang nag ngo/ ska'/ bzang gnyis/ kyis sgrig sgyur byas//yin su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chaganor nag dang ba lang gso ba'i lag rtsal/dgun dpyid gnyi gar nor nag rtswa ra ru 'tsho skyong byed thabs (1)bzhin ma btsa' skabs ji ltar bdag skyong byed tshul/ (4)ba mo 'o yod cig yin na ji ltar 'tsho skyong bya dgos/ (6)sbrum chags ba mo bdag skyong byed tshul/ (8)gsos skams la sbang ma byin na bzang / (11)ba lang la sngo rtswa byin na gsham gsal gyi gnad don gsum la mnyam 'jog bya dgos/ (12)dgun thog tshan rig ltar phyugs gso ba'i lag rtsal/(14)ba skams gso thabs/ (17)ba skams myur gso byed pa'i lag rtsal (20)lug gso ba'i lag rtsal/lug rgyud ngo sprod/ (24)lug gso ba'i shes bya 'ga'/ (31)— 1 —

lu gu lag chags pa'i khyad chos dang gso gnyer do dam byed pa'i byed thabs 'ga'/ (38)lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa'i gso skyong bdag gnyer lag rtsal/ (41)lu gu lo der gsos nas lo der btsong ba'i lag rtsal/(52)lu gu snyor skyong byed tshul/ (55)sha spyod lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa'i lag rtsal/(57)bsha' lug gso ba'i lag rtsal dang byed thabs/ (63)bsha' lug gi rgyud spel ba'i lag rtsal/ (64)bod lug la 'u ga shed 'bud du 'jug pa'i skor gyi rgyu rkyen 'ga'/ (71)dgun dpyid gnyi gar ma mor gzan chas ster dgos/(75)bsha' lug byed pa'i lug rnga leb 'tsho skyong byed tshul/(79)lug rnga leb ngo ma yin min brtag thabs/ (83)lug rnga leb nang 'dren dang 'tsho skyong bdag gnyer byed — 2 —

tshul/ (85)sgo zog la sman ldud skabs kha 'dzi dgos/ (91)phag gso ba'i lag rtsal/phag rgyud bzang bo 'ga' ngo sprod byed pa/ (94)ma bu ma bkar gong gi phag phrug gso thabs/ (100)sran khu rlon pas phag gi tshwa dug 'don thabs/ (105)

nor nag dang ba lang gso ba'i lag rtsal/dgun dpyid gnyi gar nor nag rtswa ra ru 'tsho skyong byed thabs/dang po/ dgun dus 'tsho skyong byed thabs/mdo dbus mtho sgang gi dgun gyi dus yun ring bo de ni rtswa rtsi shing skam pa dang nor gnag gi shed lhung ba'i dus skabs yin/ skabs der nga tshos nor gnag 'tsho ba'i las ka gtso bo ni shed mi lhung ba dang mngal mi shor bar bya rgyu de yin/ dgun mgo tshugs skabs thog mar phyir btsong rgyur bzhag yod pa'i g.yag skams dang 'bri skams btsongs na/dgun rtswa gron chung bya thub par ma zad/ dgos med kyi dpal 'byor gyong gud kyang thebs mi thub/ tshan rig gi dus tshigs can gyi phyugs gnyer las rigs zhes pa'i don yang 'di yin/'char gzhi med par dgun sa ru phyugs 'tsho ba des dgun sa'i rtswa yi thon tshad dang rtswa'i spus ka la gnod pas/ nor 1

nag gis dgun sa nas dgun brgal byed pa'i re ba 'grub mi thub pa red/ der brten mis bzos rtswa ra bskrun pa dang rtswa rar rtswa 'debs pa bcas byed dgos/ nor 'tsho skabs thog mar thag ring dang de nas thag nye/ thog mar ri ngos dang de nas ri 'dabs/ khangs rlung g.yug dus ri khugs nas rtswa za ba sogs byas na/ khor yug gi rtswa ra dang gsog gnyer byas pa'i sngo rtswa skam po gron chung byed thub/ spyir dgun 'khyags la nor 'phyi gtong dang snga bsdu byed dgos la/ nyin gung dro dus nor nag 'tsho ba dang nyin gung yol mtshams su chu ldud pa/mngal 'khor ba'i 'bri mo 'khyags dar che ba'i gram thang du mi 'tsho ba bcas byed dgos/ dgun dpyid la nor na ga gi sha shed mi lhung ba khag theg byed ched/ rlung bser bu chung zhing nyi 'od 'khyil sa ru phyugs khang las dgos/ dgun ma tshugs gong nas shed zhan pa'i nor gnag dang be'u/ mngal 'khor 'bri mo sogs la gzan chas 'dang tshad cig bsgrigs nas/bde 'jags ngang dgun dpyid kyi dus tshigs brgal bar byed dgos/2

gnyis pa/ dpyid dus 'tsho skyong byed thabs/dpyid kur drod tshad rim bzhin je mthor gyur pa dang sngo rtswa 'bu ba yin pas/ nor rnams ljang smyon la 'gro ba'i gnas tshul sngon 'gog byed dgos/ sngo rtswa 'bus yag yin pa dang sngo rtswa 'bus tshad mtho tshe da gzod sngo rtswa za ru 'jug dgos/dgun sa srung skyong byed ched/ nor khyu dgun sa nas dbyar sar spo dgos/ dpyid dus nor khyu 'phyi bsdu byed dgos la/bser bu rgyu sa nas rtswa za zhor du ngal gso ru 'jug pa dang zog tha thor bya nas 'tshos na bzang / de ltar byas na nor gyis dbyar sa nas rtswa 'grang tshad cig zos chog par ma zad /gzhan rten srin 'bu yi gnod pa yang je nyung du gtong thub/dbyar dus ni 'bri mo yis be'u 'khrid pa'i dus yin pas/be'u rgyun ldan ltar lag chags su 'jug chen 'bri mo'i 'o ma bzho yag byed mi nyan/mdo dbus mtho sgang ni dro yun thung ba'i sa cha zhig yin pas/ dbyar dus ni phyugs rtswa'i 'tsho bcud 'dzoms shing phyugs shed 'dzin pa'i gnad 'gag gi skabs shig yin par 3

ma zad/ 'bri mo be'u la sbyig pa'i dus tshigs bzang bo zhig kyang yin/ go skabs de 'chor du ma bcug par zog shed 'dzin dgos/bzhon ma btsa' skabs ji ltar bdag skyong byed tshul/bzhin ma btsa' skabs ni bzhon mas phru gu btsas pa'i snga phyi'i nyin bco lnga re la zer ba yin/ de'i nang du bzhon ma'i sbrum mjug dang spris ma'i dus skabs gnyis 'dus/ skabs der bzhon ma bdag skyong byed na gsham gsal gyi don tshan lngar mnyam 'jog bya dgos/dang po/ tshad ldan kro rgyu ster ba/phru gu ma btsas pa'i sngon gyi nyin bco lnga'i ring gi bzhon ma la gī rgyu dma' ba'i gzan chas ster dgos/ bzhin ma'i nyin re'i gzan chas su rgyun ldan gyi gī rgyu 'dus tshad rim bzhin je nyung du btang nas173172la 'bab tu 'jug dgos/bdag skyong byed tshul de spyad na bzhon ma'i rus rkang nang gi gī rgyu khrag gi nang du spo thub/ bzhon ma'i sbrid nad kyang sngon 'gog byed thub bo/ /4

gnyis pa/ rtswa chas do mnyam ster ba/bzhon ma lugs mthun gyis gso ba las chas mang bo ster mi rung ste/ chas ster tshad mang na gzan chas kyi ma rtsa je mthor 'gro bar ma zad/ da dung bzhon mar nad rigs sna tshogs 'byung du 'jug srid/ der brten chas dang rtswa gnyis 'os 'tsham gyis bsdebs te ster dgos/ bzhon mar gzan chas byin pa mang drags na be'u btsas nas nyin 'ga'i nang gcin du thong 'dres pa'i nad ngan 'byung bas na/ skabs der nyin rer chas ster tshad bzhon ma'i lus phung gi ljid tshad kyi1lā)las brgal mi rung /gsum pa/ tshwa khu nyung ster byed pa/be'u ma btsas pa'i sngon gyi nyin15yas mas su/ bzhon mar tshwa khu ster tshad je nyung du gtong ba dang mnyam du 'os 'tsham gyis bzhon ma'i 'gul skyod kyi tshad je mang du gtong dgos/ de ltar byas na bzhon ma'i btsas rjes kyi nu mar chu ser gsog pa'i nad sngon 'gog byed thub/bzhi ba/ 'o ma bzho grangs lugs mthun yin dgos/bzhon mas be'u btsas rjes kyi nyin dang por/ nyin rgyun 5

gyi 'o ma bzho tshad kyi173las bzho mi rung ba dang / btsas rjes kyi nyin gnyis pa nas bzung / rim bzhin bzhin ma'i bzhi tshad je mang du gtong dgos/ nyin bzhi ba dang lnga bar bslebs na bzhon ma'i spri dkar dang lus phung rgyun ldan du 'gyur bas/ de'i rjes nas 'o ma rgyun ldan ltar bzhis chogade ltar byas na bzhon mar nu tsha rgyas pa sngon 'gog byed thub pa dang / 'o ma'i spus tshad je legs su gtong thub/ba mo 'o yod cig yin na ji ltar 'tsho skyong bya dgos/ba mo 'o yod cig(phyi gling gi ba rgyud bshad pa yin)yin na/ lo rer 'o ma spyi rgya6000yan bzhis chog pa red/ der brten/ ba mo 'o yod cig la 'tsho bcud phun sum tshogs pa zhig mkho ba yin/ ba mo 'o yod cig la ma mtha' yang nyin rer gzan chas spyi rgya'izhanas spyi rgya100(gzan chas skam po'i dbang du btang na spyi ༅0)byin te/ ba mo'i gzugs phung skye khams kyi dgos mkho bskang dgos/ba mo 'o yod cig gi nyin re'i gzan chas ni 'tsho bcud cha tshang ba dang / rigs sna phun sum tshogs pa/ 'ju ba dang 6

sdud len byed sla ba zhig yin dgos/ spyir btang du spus legs sngo rtswa skam po dang / gsog nyar sngo rtswa'i gzan chas/ khu ba mod pa'i sngo rtswa'i gzan chas sogs nyin rgyun gyi gzan chas kyi rmang gzhi byed pa dang mnyam du gzan chas spus legs ster dgos/ lag len las byung ba'i ra sprod ltar na/ ba mo 'o yod kyi 'o ma'i thon tshad mi lhung ba'i ched du gzan chas spus legs gcig pu'i ster tshad je mang du gtong mi rung / gal te gzan chas spus legs ster tshad mang drags na/ re zhig 'o ma'i thon tshad mtho rung / thon tshad mtho ba'i dus yun ring mi srid par ma zad/ ba mo'i bde thang la'ang gnod pa yod/ba mo 'o yod kyi nyin rgyun gyi gzan chas mang nyung gi tshad dang spus tshad la khag theg bya dgos/ gzan chas khrod 'o ma thon par nges par du mkho ba'i le an son dang si an son/cin an son sogs an cis son gyi rigs mang bo yod dgos/ rgyas par bshad na ba mo 'o yod cig gi nyin re'i gzan chas nang du spri dkar ci tsam mod na/ 'o ma'i thon tshad kyang de bzhin du je mthor 'gro ba yin/ da dung nyin 7

re'i gzan chas nang du gzan sna bsdebs pa'i sdur tshad ji 'dra'i 'os 'tsham yin na/ 'o ma'i spus tshad kyang de tsam gyis bzang ba yin/ba mo 'o yod kyi za tshad mang bas/ spyir nyin rer gzan chas thengs4yan ster ba dang / chu theng4yan sdud dgos so//sbrum chags ba mo bdag skyong byed tshul/dgun kha ni ba mor sbrum chags skabs yin pas/ sbrum chags ba mos grang ngar gyi 'jab rgol 'gog dgos la mngal gnas phru gu 'tshar longs yong bar mkho ba'i 'tsho bcud kyang mkho sprod byed dgos/ gal te bdag skyong gang 'tsham zhig ma byas pa dang / khyad par du gnam gshis glo bur du gyur nas 'khyag ltogs bkres skom gyis mnar skabs/ sbrum chags ba mo'i shed lhung ba dang nad 'gog nus pa nyams te/ phru gu 'phyis pa dang phru gu skye dka' ba/ yang na ma bu mnyam shi sogs byed srid/ sbrum chags ba mo bdag skyong gang legs bya ched gsham gyi byed thabs 'ga' lag bstar byed dgos/8

dang po/ phyugs khang nyams gso bya dgos/sbrum chags ba mo la khong rgya che ba'i phyugs khang bskrun pa dang / 'tshang kha rgyag pa dang 'phra yis rgyag pa sogs kyi gnod pa med tshe be'u mi 'phyis par phan/ phyugs khang ni mkha' dbugs rgyu thub pa dang drod bsrung thub pa/ skam zhing gtsang ma zhig yin dgos/gnyis pa/ sems zhib mos gso dgos/ba mor sbrum chags rjes rang mkho 'tsho bcud dgos par ma zad/ mngal gnas phru gur 'tshar longs 'byung ba'i 'tsho bcud bskang ba dang mnyam du 'tsho bcud nges can zhig gsog 'jog byas te be'u btsas rjes kyi 'o ma zags thon byed par khag theg bya dgos/der brten zla rer gzan chas spus dag stong khe1nas2bar ster dgos pa dang / cha rkyen yod tshe spus dag mnyam bsres gzan chas ster dgos/ de'i bsre tshad ni ma rmos lo tog30lta) dang sran snyigs20༅ 'bras sob155 sring 'bru snyigs ma15༅ 'ba' 'tha5 'bras shun155bcas yin/9

gcin rgyu dang gzan chas bsres te gsos na spri dkar kha snon gyi go chod pa yin/ gcin rgyu'i ster tshad nyin rer sbrum chags ba mo'i lus kyi ljid tshad stong kho100rer khe40ri byin na bzang /gsum pa/ be'u 'phyis pa sngon 'gog dang ma bu'i bde thang la khag theg bya dgos/dgun khar sbrum chags ba mo la 'tsho skyong legs po ma byas na be'u 'phyis sla/ de'i nad rtags ni dang thog sbrum chags dus skye lam nas 'byar khu bzhur ba dang rgyun du kha phyir 'khor te gsus par lta ba/ yar lang mar nyal byas te mi bde ba'i tshul ston pa red/ be'u btsa' khar nu ma'i gsher rmen skrangs pa dang rked pa gug pa/ thengs gang mang la rdzing gtong ba'i bzo lta byed pa/ gsus khog la zug gzer mngon gsal byung ba dang be'u 'gul mtshams 'jog pa bcas yin/sman bcos bya na sha gnad du hong this thung dza0 5nas khe1 0bar rgyag pa dang nyin rer thengs1re bstud mar nyin4nas nyin6la brgyab tshe phan 'bras legs po 'thob thub/10

gsos skams la sbang ma byin na bzang /sba/nga ma ni chang bsnyal ba'i 'bru snyigs yin pas/ nang na phye nges can zhig 'dus yod par ma zad/ da rung spri dkar dkyus ma sna mang yang 'dus yod pas ma rmos lo tog gi 'tsho bcud 'dus tshad las ldab2nas ldab3gyis mtho zhing / tshad nyung ma rgyu dang 'tsho bcud/ phab rtsi sogs 'dus yod/ de'i nang du la'e an son dang / tan an son/ si an son bcas kyi 'dus tshad ha cang mtho ba red/ 'tsho bcud de dag rtswa skya yis mkho spro da byed mi thub/ gzhan yang sbang ma'i grub cha'i nang gi gzan chas dkyus ma'i 'dus tshad kyang cung mtho/sbang ma tshang ma ni chang gi phab btab rjes drod tshad mthon pos rlangs/ btsos byas te grub pa yin pas/ tshi sna rtsing po'i 'dus tshad cung dma' gzan chas byas na kha la zhim pa dang 'ju sla ba'i khyad chos ldan par ma zad/ da rung gsos skams kyi pho ba sba sa pa sngon 'gog byed thub pa red/gsos skams la sbang ma nyin20nas nyin30yas mas byin na/ gsos skams gyi spu kha je yag dang je 'jam du 'gyur 11

srid/ sbang mas gsos pa'i skams sha ni sbang mas ma gsos pa'i skams sha las sha rgyu bzang ba dang / tshi sna phra ba/ 'od mdangs gsal ba/ sha rkyang30(7)nasaci0(7〉je mthor song yod/dang thog sbang ma ster dus gsos skams kha shas kyis zos na mi 'dod pa'i gnas tshul 'byung srid/ der nyin3nas nyin5la za lob byed du 'jug dgos/ba lang la sngo rtswa byin na gsham gsal gyi gnad don gsum la mnyam 'jog bya dgos/dbyar ston gnyis ka ni sngo rtswa rab tu rgyas pa'i sgang yin/ba lang la mtshon na sngo rtswa ni ljang mdog mig la mdzes shing /khu ba mang bo ldan pa/ 'ju sla ba bcas kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i kha zas yin/ der spri dkar dang an cis son/ we hrin su'u/gter rgyu sogs ha cang mang bo 'dus yod/ gsham nas ba lang la sngo rtswa ster bar mnyam 'jog bya dgos pa 'ga' mtshams sbyor byed par bya ste/gcig gzan chas gcig rkyang ster mi rung /sngo rtswa ni ba lang gso bar med du mi rung ba'i gzan chas 12

legs po zhig yin/ yin na'ang sngo rtswar sngo khu 'dus tshad mang drags pas/ (sngo rtswa stong khe1000re'i nang du khu ba stong de'i00'dus pa yin)/ gzan chas skam po'i nang du sngo khu 'dus tshad ha cang dma'/ gal te sngo rtswa kho na bsha' zog la byin na/des batha' zog gi grod pu 'grang bar byed srid mod/ 'on kyang lus sha rgyas pa'am sha shed gsog pa'i dgos mkho bskang mi thub/ de bas ba lang la sngo rtswa ster skabs nges par du sngo rtswa skam po dang 'bru rigs(ma rmos lo tog dang khre rgod sogs)/spri dkar ldan pa'i gzan chas(sran snyigs dang ba dam gyi 'ba' cha sogs)sogs tshad ran po zhig bsres nas ster dgos/ de ltar byas na da gzod ba lang la shed mong 'bud du 'jug thub/gnyis pa/ dug phog par sngon 'gog byed pa/ba lang la gsher khu mod pa'i sngo rtswa'i gzan chas ster skabs/ gcig ni phyogs gcig tu spungs yun ring ba'i tshod ma'i lo ma yi rigs ster mi rung ste/dper na la phug dang tshod dkar gyi lo ma sogs)/ rgyu mtshan ni der rdzas sna zha'o son 13

yan 'dus pa dang / rul sungs 'bu phra yis zha'o son yan de rdzas sna ya zha'o son yan la bsgyur thub pas/ ba lang gis zos na 'chi nyen yod/ gnyis pa ni ma rmos lo tog bi rmyu gu dang / khre rgod kyi myu gu sogs ster mi rung / rgyu mtshan ni de dag gi nang na rdzas sna chin kun 'dres pas/ ba lang bis zos rjes grod pu ru rdzas sna chin chun son byung ste 'chi ru 'jug srid/gsum pa/ thengs gcig la sngo rtswa mang ster byed mi rung /sran rigs gzan rtswa'i(dper na 'bu su hang)nang du spri dkar dang we hrin su'u/ tshad nyung ma rgyu sogs mang du 'dus pas/ ba lang gis zos pa mang drags na/ grod pu'i nang du wu ba mang bo byung nas sbos nad 'byung nyen yod/dgun thog tshan rig ltar phyugs gso ba'i lag rtsal/dgun thog grang ngar che ba dang nangs dgong gi drod grang la bar khyad che bar ma zad/ 'khyags yun kyang shin tu ring /de bas dgun thog phyugs zos/ gso na gsham gsal gyi bya ba 'ga' legs par bsgrub dgos/ 14

dang po/ phyugs khang zhig gso bya dgos/dgun thog phyugs khang gis grang lhags ma khogs na phyugs zog la cham nad sogs 'byung sla bar ma zad/ phyugs zog gis grang ngar 'gog pa'i lus drod yal te sha shed lhung srid pas/ phyugs khang ni bser kha min par kha lho lta yin pa'i skam sa ru brtsig dgos/ dgun ma bslebs pa'i sngon la phyugs khang gis grang ngar dang bser bu khogs ched snga mo nas zhig gso legs po bya dgos/ rab yin na sgo dang dra ma thams cad rtswa stan dang ras/ phying ba sogs kyis bkab ste drod bskyil dgos/gnyis pa/ dus thog tu rdzing rtswa brje dgos/sa rlan len ched ba lang gi 'og la rdzing rtswa btings te lus drod bsrung dgos/ rdzing rtswa dus thog tu ma brjes na nem bzung ste phyugs zog la nad 'byung du 'jug srid pas/ rdzing rtswa rlon pa yin phyin dus thog tu brje dgos/ gnam ngo bzang dus phyugs khang gi sgo dang dra ma phye nas bser bu rgyu ru bcug ste/ phyugs khang nang gi an dang dbyang gnyis than 'gyur 15

sogs gnod ldan mkha' dbugs yal du 'jug dgos/gsum pa/ phyugs khyu legs sgrig bya dgos/dgun thog 'os 'tsham gyi sgo nas phyugs zog la 'tshang kha rgyag tu 'jug dgos/ de ltar byas na phyugs zog phan tshun gyis gcig gis gcig la glan te khang ba'i nang du drod bskyil thub bo/ /yin na'ang phru gu btsas pa'i mo zog dang sbrum yod pa'i mo zog kha bkar te rang rang sa ru 'gog dgos/bzhi ba/ phyugs nad sngon 'gog bya dgos/phyugs khang la dus bcad ltar gtsang sbra dang dug sel bya dgos pa dang / rgyun mthong nad rigs sngon 'gog byed pa'i ched du nad ma byung gong la 'gog sman rgyag dgos par ma zad/ nad byung ba'i phyugs zog la dus thog tu lta zhib sman bcos bya dgos/ dgun thog phyugs zog gi lus la gzhan rten srin 'bu 'byung sla bas/ tis pe khrung dang a we con su'u sogs kyi zog sman spyad de khog 'bu 'phud pa dang mnyam du phyi spyod tis pe khrung sman chu dang khru'u man cin sogs 'bu gsod sman rdzas spyad de lus steng gi srin 'bu gsod dgos/16

lnga ba/ gso skyong bdag gnyer shugs snon bya dgos/dgun thog grang ngar che ba dang phyugs zog gi sha shed lhung srid pas/ bcud ldan gzan chas je mang la gtong ba dang mnyam du gzan chas kyi mang nyung dang gzan chas ster ba'i dus tshod gtan khel bya dgos/ chu drod 'jam ldud pa dang / rab yin na dgong mo dgong rtswa thengs gcig la ster dgos/ 'khyags la 'byar ba dang rul yod pa'i gzan chas gtan nas ster mi rung bar ma zad/ nangs mo nyi ma drod la 'bab dus phyugs zog ri la rgyag pa dang / phyi dro nyi ma tshang la ma bzhud pa'i sngon la phyugs zog bsdus te phyugs khang du 'gog dgos/ bad brgyab pa dang 'khyags la 'byar ba'i rtswa zos te byung ba'i nad rigs sngon 'gog bya dgos/ba skams gso thabs/dang po/ ba rgyud bzang dgos/deng skabs rgyal nang du gso bzhin pa'i ba skams kyi ba rgyud ni zhi min tha er dang / zha lo la'e/ li mu'u tsan/ nan te wun sogs kyi ba rgyud 'dres pa'i ba lang yin/ ba skams 17

de dag ni sa lhag mi 'khur ba dang / gzan chas la kha 'dems med pa/ shed mong 'bud sla ba bcas kyi bzang cha ldan pa red/gnyis pa/ ba skams la chang blud na sha shed 'bud sla/gzan chas kyi nang du chang 'os 'tsham zhig bsres na ba skams lag chags tshad je mgyogs su gtong thub/ nyin rer ba skams re'i gzan chas kyi nang du chang dkar khe10dang yang na wu chang khye50bsres na phan 'bras de bas bzang ba dang /lag chags tshad205yan je mthor 'gro bar ma zad/ skams sha'i rgyu spus ni de bas kyang bzang ba red/gsum pa/ dgun dpyid gnyis mar ba skams la snum zas ster dgos/drod tshudaX08las dma' ba'i dus su ba skams kyi sha shed rgyas pa de 'dra'i bsam thog la 'ong ba zhig min/ dus der gang thub kyis snum chas byin te/ shed mong 'bud du 'jug dgos/ snum chas ni ba skams la 'tsho bcud mkho sprod dang lus steng du 'tsho bcud gsog tu 'jug pa'i gzan chas phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin par ma zad/ we hrin so'u〉 ba ༅dang 18

dgu ba/ dgun thog lug bde 'jags kyis 'tsho bar ro snang bya dgos pa'i gnad 'gag bcu/gcig lug khang gi mdun mtho zhing rgyab dma' dgos la/ sgo lho lta yin na shing cha gron chung byed thub par ma zad/nyi 'od la brten nas drod 'dzin pa la'ang phan no//gnyis/ lug nad 'gog bcos dang ston shed 'bud pa la do snang byed pa dang mnyam du dgun rtswa 'dang tshad cig gra sgrig bya dgos/gsum/ che lug dang chung lug stobs che ba dang stobs zhan pa/ sha shed yod pa'i lug dang sha shed med pa'i lug rnams nges par du lug khang so sor bkar nas bkag ste/ sha shed med pa'i lug dang chung lug sogs gcir du 'jug mi rung /bzhi/ grang ngar che ba'i dgong mor lu gu 'gog sa'i lug khang gi sgo rtswa gdan gyis gcod dgos/ de ltar byas na drod 'dzin par phan no//lnga/ rlung dang kha gtad de lug sgor phud pa dang rlung 36

dang bsdebs nas lug lug lhas la 'gog pa rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ lug rnams rim bzhin grang ngar la lob tu 'jug dgos/ grang ngar che skabs lug thag nye sa nas 'tsho dgos/de ltar byas na lug gi 'gul tshad rgyun srung byas chog la/lug gis rtswa'ang cung tsam rgum thub/ dgun dus su lug 'phyi 'gog byas na bal mi lhung bar phan no//drug rtswa chu 'dzoms shing sa dro ba'i rtswa sa bdams nas lug 'tsho dgos/bdun/ brtan chags bzhi ste lug lug lhas nas sgor phud pa brtan chags dang / lug 'tsho yun brtan chags/lug lug lhas la bskyil ba brtan chags/ chu dang gzan chas ster ba brtan chags bcas yin dgos/brgyad/ lug la nyin rer chu thengs gcig la ldud dgos/chu ldud pa'i dus ni phyi dro'i chu tshod gnyis kyi yas mas yin na 'tshams/ lto stong la chu ldud mi rung bar ma zad/ rul chu'ang 'thung du 'jug mi rung ngo / /dgu/ nyin bcu re'i nang du tshwa thengs gcig la ster ba 37

dang / ster thengs rer lug rer tshwa khu kho10ri ster dgos/ chu 'thungs rjes tshwa ldud dgos/bcu/ dgun dus nges par du lug lhas skam po yin dgos/ nyin rgyun lug lhas gtsang sbra byas te/ ril ma phyags dgos par ma zad/ rgyun du lu gu'i rnam 'gyur la zhib lta byas te/ nad byung ba'i tshe na dus thog du nad bcos bya dgos/lu gu lag chags pa'i khyad chos dang gso gnyer do dam byed pa'i byed thabs 'ga'/dang po/ 'o spri 'grang tshad cig sdud dgos/lug gu btsas nas dus tshod1nas3gyi nang du 'o spri bsnun dgos/ 'o spri ni ma mos lu gu btsas rjes kyi dus tshod1nas3gyi nang la zags thon byas pa'i 'o ma yin/ 'o spri ni rgyun ldan gyi 'o ma dang mi 'dra bar ser zhing gar bo zhig yin 'a// der spri dkar dang zhag tshil/ yon ci son/ 'tsho bcud sogs rdzas sna phun sum tshogs pa 'dus par ma zad/ gter rgyu yi 'dus tshad kyang mtho/ rmā zhes pa'i lcags rgyu'i 'dus tshad de bas 38

mtho ba zhig yin/ de'i nad 'gog nus stobs che bas 'bu phra yi gnod pa 'gog thub/ 'o spri de lu gu'i bde thang la 'brel ba khyad par can yod pas/ 'o spri lu gus nu ma thub na lu gu lag chags par gnod pa chen po bzo srid/gnyis pa/ rgyun ldan 'o mas gso ba/ma mos lu gu btsas nas dus tshod3'gor nas/ ma mo'i 'o ma bsrad rag bar gyi 'o ma la rgyun ldan 'o ma zer/ lu gu btsas te ga/za' 'ga'i nang ma mo'i 'o mar brten nas 'tsho ba yin/ de bas ma mo'i gzan chas kyi nang du spus dag gzan chas dang khu ldan gzan chas bsres nas/ lu gu la 'o ma 'dang tshad cig mkho sprod byed du 'jug dgos/ lu gu mtshe ma yin na ma mo gzhan gyi nu ma bsnun dgos/gsum pa/ lu gur gzan chas lob tu 'jug dgos/lu gu yag po zhig lag chags su 'jug na/ 'o ma yid tshim pa zhig nu ru 'jug dgos par ma zad/ snga mo nas gzan chas ster lob byas na/ lu gu'i pho ba'i 'ju stobs bde thang ngang rgyas par byed pa dang lu gu'i lus gzhi dar ba la 39

phan no/ /lu gu btsas nas gza' 'khor gcig 'gor rjes/ma mo'i rjes ded de rtswa snyi mo za bar lob tu chugs/ de nas lu gur gzan chas lob tu 'jug par thog mar ma rmos lo tog gi phye dang sran phye bsres nas phye khu bskol te ldud dgos/ de min brngos zin pa'i spus dag gzan chas snod du bzhag ste lu gu la dri zhim snom du bcug rjes/ yang dang yang du khar gtad de ldag par byed du bcug na che lug bzhin gzan chas 'phrog rtsod byas nas za ba yin/bzhi ba/ dus thog tu nu mtshams gcod pa/lu gu lag chags pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs nas tshan rig dang mthun par nu mtshams gcod dgos/ nu mtshams bcad pa'i lu gu ma mo dang cung rgyang thag ring ba'i lug ra'i nang du 'gog dgos/ de ltar ma byas na lu gus a mar bltas nas 'ba' ste ma bu gnyis kyi rtswa za bar gnod pa bzo nges yin/40

lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa'i gso skyong bdag gnyer lag rtsal/lu gu'i sha thon skyed byas na dgun sa'i khur bo je yang dang / gzan chas dang phyugs khang gi 'gro song je nyung du btang ste/ tshong zog tu 'gyur tshad je mtho dang ma rtsa'i 'gro gron je nyung du gtong bar mngon gsal gyi phan nus thon pa red/dang po/ lu gu'i sha thon skyed byed pa'i dgos dbang /gcig lu gu'i sha thon skyed byas na lug gi thon las phyogs yongs nas brtan po'i sgo nas gong 'phel du gtong thub/ lug gi thon las ni deng rabs can gyi chu tshad cung mtho ba'i lug bal gyi thon skyed ma lag dang lug sha'i thon skyed ma lag gnyis las grub pa'i thon las shig yin/ lu gu'i sha thon skyed byed pa'i dmigs yul ni lug sha thon skyed byed pa gong du spel ba'i dmigs yul gtso bo zhig yin par ma zad/ rang 'gul rang bzhin ha cang ldan pa'i lug sha thon skyed byed pa'i ma lag cig kyang yin/ lu gu'i sha thon skyed 41

byed pa de lug kha gang la brten nas lug sha thon skyed byed pa'i ga(nan 'gul ma lag dang bsdur na mngon gsal gyi khyad par yod do//gnyis/ lu gu'i sha yi khyad chos/ lu gu'i sha ni sha dri bro zhing sha rnyi mo yin pa dang / sha gnag mang zhing tshil nyung ba/sha khu mang zhing dri ngan mi bro ba bcas kyi khyad chos dang ldan pas/ zos na 'ju sla ba dang lus kyi zungs shugs rgyas thub/gsum/ lu gu'i sha thon skyed byed pa'i dpal 'byor gyi dge mtshan/ lu gu'i sha thon skyed byed pa ni dbyar sa dang ston sa bed spyod gang legs byas te dgun zog 'dzin pa je nyung du btang ba de yin pas/ phyugs zog dang gza na rtswa bar gyi 'gal ba sel thub par ma zad/ phyugs khyu'i 'khor skyod je mgyogs su btang ba dang mnyam du lug gi bsha' tshad dang tshong zog tu 'gyur tshad je mthor gtong thub/ lo de'i lu gu mang bo gsos te tshong rar sprad na lug khyu'i nang gi mo lug je mang du gtong thub/ lu gu btsas nas rṣa'agor rjes bshas na/ de'i dpal 'byor gyi yong sgo ni 'di lta ste/ gcig na sha 42

rkyang 'bud pa dang / gnyis na shed mong mi lhung ba/ gsum na gzan rtswa gron chung byed thub pa/ bzhi na ngal rtsol pa'i 'gro gron je nyung du 'gro ba/ lnga na lug khang(ra)de 'dra chen po mi dgos pa bcas kyi dge mtshan ldan no//bzhi/ lu gu'i sha thon skyed byed pa 'don spel bya dgos/lu gu'i sha thon skyed byas na ma dngul gtong mi dgos pa dang lo mjug la lug grangs je mang la gtong mi dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'og tu phyugs khyu 'khor skyod byed pa je mgyogs dang /dpal 'byor yong sgo bskrun pa je mang du gtong thub par zad/lug gso ba'i khe las phyogs yongs nas lhing 'jigs kyi sgo nas gong 'phel du gtong thub/gnyis pa/ lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug par mnyam 'jog bya dgos pa'i gnad don 'ga'/gcig ni sdeb sbyor la brten nas lag chags sla ba dang lu gu btsa' tshad mtho ba'i ma mo bdams te shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa'i lu gu thon skyed bya dgos/ gnyis ni dpyid ma/go dang dgun thog lu gu btsa' ru bcug na lu gu dgun thog 43

bar du lag chags yun te thon skyed byed yun je ring du song na lu gu'i sha khog je ljid la gtong bar phan no/ /gsum ni nu ma nu skabs ma mo dang lu gu'i gso skyong bdag gnyer la shugs snon byed pa dang / snga mo nas lu gu'i nu ma nu mtshams (nu'i'agor rjes nu mtshams gcod pa)bcad de/ gzhug phyogs shed mong 'bud du 'jug par rmang gzhi 'ding dgos/gsum pa/ lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa'i gnad 'gag gi lag rtsal/gcig sdeb sbyor byas pa'i lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa lag bstar bya dgos/ rang rgyal gyi sa cha so so na rang gi sa cha'i rang byung cha rkyen dang 'tshams shing / sa lob chu lob yin zhing kha 'dem med pa'i sa gnas kyi 'u/ga rgyud bzang bo yod/ yin na'ang lug rgyud 'di dag la lag chags yun ring ba dang / thon skyed byed nus kyi tshad dma' ba bcas kyi zhan cha yod/ sdeb sbyor byas pa'i lug rgyud spel ba ni 'di lta ste/ sa gnas kyi lug rgyud bzang bo dang nang 'dren byas pa'i lug rgyud bzang bo gnyis sdeb sbyor byas te 44

shed mong bud yod pa'i lu gu thon skyed byas nas lo der bshas na/ sdeb sbyor gyi yon tan bed spyad par ma zad/ sa gnas lug rgyud kyi phul byung khyad chos kyang do dam byas pa yin/ de'i nang don ni nang 'dren byas pa'i rgyud bzang sha lug dang sa gnas kyi lug rgyud bzang bo gnyis kyi dpal 'byor sdeb sbyor byed pa dang / sdeb sbyor byas pa'i lu gu gsos te tsho 'bud du 'jug pa de yin/gnyis/ gzan chas 'os 'tsham sgos sdeb sgrig bya dgos/lu gu la shed mong 'bud du 'jug skabs zas bcud kyi tshad gzhi ltar nyin re'i gzan chas bsdeb dgos/ nyin re'i gzan chas kyi nang gi gzan chas spus legs dang gzan chas dkyus ma sna 'dzoms yin dgos par ma zad/ lu gus zos na 'dod dgos/ sna kha mang ba'i gzan chas 'os 'tsham sgos bsdeb pa dang / zas bcud kyi grub cha sna tshogs kyis phan tshun la ram 'degs byas na/ da gzod bcud 'dzoms gzan chas su gyur te lus tshad je ljid la 'gro tshad je mgyogs su gtong thub/ da lta lug ri nas 'tsho skyong byed pa'i 45

rnam pa de khang ba'i nang du 'tsho skyong byed pa'i rnam par 'gyur bzhin yod/ mi rnams kyis lu gu khang ba'i nang du gsos na lo rtswa byin chog snyarma/ mod/ 'on kyang lo rtswa'i nang gi zas bcud ha cang zhan par ma zad/ bed spyod byed tshad kyang ha cang dma' bas/ 'o/ rtswa rkyang rkyang gis lu gu gso mi thub par nges par du gzan rtswa gzhan dag dang gzan chas spus legs bsres te lu gu gso dgos / rgyu mtshan ni lo rtswa rkyang rkyang gis lu gu'i tshe bsring ba tsam las lu gu la sha shed 'bud du 'jug mi thub bo/ /gsum/ ma mo bslus te lu gu btsa' ru 'jug pa/ ma mo bslus te lu gu btsa' ru 'jug pa ni ma mor mngal chags te nyin140'gor ba na/ sha gseng du yis kri le ku'u khrong ste thang phis kri le ku'u khrong ho khe16brgyab na/ dus tshod12'gor rjes ma mo105yis lu gu btsa' srid/ lu gu de ltar btsas na chabs cig tu bsdus te bdag gnyer bya sla bar ma zad/ ma mor chabs cig tu lu gu 'dzin du 'jug pa dang chabs cig tu lu gu btsa' ru 'jug thub bo//46

bzhi ba/ lu gur shed cho nga 'bud du 'jug pa'i lag rtsal/gcig lu gur snga mo nas nu mtshams gcod du 'jug pa/lu gu btsas rjes snga mo nas nu mtshams gcod pa dang / de nas khog 'bu phyir ded de btsan dbang gis zla1nas zal gsos te shed mong 'bud du 'jug dgos/gnyis/ lu gur spri ma nu ru 'jug dgos/ lu gu btsas nas nyi ma1nas nyi ma3gyi nang la lu gur spri ma nu ru 'jug pa dang dus thog tu mngal rtug gtong du 'jug dgos/ ma mo'i spri ma'i nang du phun sum tshogs pa'i spri dkar dang tshil snum/rims 'gog rdzas sna/ we hrin su'u dang ma'e tshwa sogs mod po 'dus pas/ lu gu'i lus shugs dar ba dang nad yams 'gog pa/ mngal rtug gtong ba bcas la phan nus gal chen 'don srid/ der brten/ lu gu yar langs te nu ma nu skabs ram 'degs byas nas spri ma nu ru 'jug dgos/ lu gus nu ma nu skabs rnga ma g.yug pa dang / nu ma nus rjes ma/go g.yug pa yin/ gal te lu gus nu ma nu skabs mgo rdung byed zhor du 'ba' na/ ma mor 'o ma med pa'am 'o ma nyung ba'i rtags 47

yin/gsum/ gzan chas kyis gso bar shugs snon byed dgos/ lu gu btsas nas nyi ma7nas nyi ma10'gor te/ lu gus gzan rtswa dang btung chu kha reg pa na/ sngo rtswa skam po ster ba dang btung chu ldud mgo brtsam dgos/ lu gu 'gog sar nam yin yang sngo rtswa skam po dang gzan chas btags ma/ ldag tshwa/btung chu gtsang ma sogs gra sgrig byas te/ lu gur snga mo nas gzan rtswa bza' ru 'jug dgos/bzhi/ dus thog tu nu ma nu mtshams gcod dgos/ lu gu btsas nas nyi ma90nas nyi ma120'gor rjes/ lu gu lag chags pa'i gzugs tshad la gzhigs te nu mtshasam gcod dgos/ nu mtshams gcod pa la thabs lam gnyis yod de/gcig ni dus thengs gcig la nu mtshams gcod pa dang /cig shos ni snol sdeb byas nas nu mtshams gcod pa de yin/dus thengs gcig la nu mtshams gcod pa ni nu mtshams gcod pa'i lu gu'i khyu ru che lug btang ste/ lu gur btung chu 'thung ba dang gzan rtswa bza' ba lob tu 'jug dgos/ snol 48

sdeb byas nas nu mtshams gcod pa ni lu gu dang ma mo brjes te nu ma nu grangs je nyung du gtong ba de yin/lnga/ nu mtshasam bcad pa'i lu gur mgyogs myur sgos shed mong 'bud du 'jug na 'di ltar bya dgos to/1 shed mong 'bud du 'jug grabs yod pa'i lu gu gso skyong bdag gnyer byed tshul/ nu mtshams bcad pa'i lu gu sa cha gzhan zhig la bskyal te shed mong 'bud du 'jug na/ thog mar lu gu dag chabs cig tu bsdus te btung chu mi ldud pa dang gzan chas mi ster bar zhag ma gcig la lto stong du bskyur rjes/ phyi nyin snga mo nas rgya mar tshad de bskyal dgos/khor yug gis lu gu 'drog tu mi 'jug pa'i ched du rlangs 'khor du rem par 'jog dgos/ lu gu 'gog sa'i lug khang lhing 'jags yin dgos par ma zad/ btung chu 'grang tshad cig blud rjen zos na 'ju sla ba'i sngo rtswa skam po ster dbos/de nas khog 'bu 'ded pa dang 'gog sman rgyag dgos/ lu gu che chung ltar khyu bkar rjes yun thung thung zhig gi nang du gzan chas byin te shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa dang / snga mo 49

nas tshong rar bskyal te dpal 'byor gyi yong sgo bskrun dgos/gzugs chung ba'i lu gur spus zhan gzan chas ster ba dang /lo rtswa'i gzan chas kyis60 7(7zin chog la/ lu gur lus shugs rgyas rjes gso skyong legs po byas te shed mong 'bud du bcug choganyi ma2nas nyi ma3'gor te khor yug la lobs pa na/ lu gur gra sgrig byas yod pa'i gzan chas ster mgo brtsams chog nyin rer gzan chas thengs2la ster ba dang / thengs re'i gzan chas ster tshad ni chu tshod skar ma30nas skar ma7/5yi nang du zos tshar na rab yin/ mi 'dang na kha snon byas chog pa dang mang song na gtsang phyags bya dgos/ lu gur kha ra 'dang tshad re dgos pa dang btung chu mtshams mi chad par ldud dgos/ gzan chas ster tshad je mang du gtong ba dang /yang na gzan chas kyi sdeb ka brjes na ma mtha' yang nyi ma3gyi lob yun yod dgos/2 lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug yun gyi nang gi gso skyong bdag gnyer byed tshul/ gso skyong bdag gnyer sta gon 50

byed yun mjug bsgril rjes lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa'i saso skyong bdag gnyer ngo ma byas chog skabs der shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa'i 'char gzhi dang sa gnas de'i cha rkyen/ ljid tshad je mgyogs su gtong ba bcas gzhir bzung ste gzan chas 'dems dgos/ gzan chas la spus legs gzan chas dang spus zhan gzan chas/ sngo nyar gzan chas sogs rigs gsum yod/ gso skyong bdag gnyer byed skabs gang la gang 'tsham gyis gzan chas ster dgos / lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug par go rim gsum yod de/ go rim dang po nyi ma1nas nyi ma3yin la/ skabs der lo rtswa rkyang rkyang byin te lu gu khor yug gsar bar lob tu 'jug dbos/ go rim gnyis pa nyi ma7nas nyi ma10yin la/ nyi ma3'gor rjes rim bzhin du go rim gnyis pa'i gzan chas ster dgos/ nyi ma15la gso skyong sta gon byas rjes lu gur shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa'i gso skyong bdag gnyer ngo ma bya dgos/51

lu gu lo der gsos nas lo der btsong ba'i lag rtsal/dang po/ ma mor snga mo nas sdeb sbyor bya dgos/thon skyed byed pa'i ma mor ci thub kyis snga mo nas sdeb sbyor byas te/ dgun kha dang sos kya'i lu gu bsnyor na/ lo de'i lu gu lo der gso skyong byas te btsongs chog pa yin/gnyis pa/ dgun brgal lug khang 'geb dgos/dgun brgal lug khang bkab ste/ 'dzin lug ma mo dgun brgal byed par khor yug legs po mkho sprod byed dgos/ dgun kha dang sos ma'i lu gu len par cha rkyen bskrun nas/ lu gu lo der gso skyong byas te lo der btsong thub pa khag theg bya dgos/gsum pa/ gzan chas bzang shos tsā snon bya dgos/ma mos lu gu sbrum skabs gzan chas legs gras ster dgos/ lu gu btsas nas nu ma nu skabs ma mo dang lu gu gnyis kur gzan chas ster dgos par ma zad/ lu gu gso ba'i go rim hril bor gzan chas byin te ston dus phyir btsongs chog pa'i tshad la bsleb tu 'jug dgos/ lo de'i lu gu lo der gso skyong byas te phyir btsong na nges par du gzan 52

chas legs gras ster rgyu ni byed thabs gtso bo zhig yin la dgos nges kyi byed thabs shig kyang yin/ bsha' lug ni skyug ldad srog chags yin pa'i cha nas spri dkar gyi 'tsho bcud med na gcin rgyu bkol spyod byed pa khyab gdal bya dgos/ dgos mkho ltar zan leb mang bo bcos nas phyugs 'tsho skabs lug la ldag tu 'jug pa ni las sla zhing stabs bde zhig yin pas/'brog phyogs su khyab gdal kyang byed sla ba red/bzhi ba/ dgun dpyid brgal skabs kyi gzan chas mi 'dang ba'i gnad don thag gcod bya dgos/gzan rtswa dang gzan chas ni phyugs las gong du spel ba'i nyag sgo yin zhing / rtswa dang phyugs kyi 'gal zla gtso bo ni dgun dpyid kyi dus tshigs yin pas/ gzan rtswa dang gzan chas kyi gnad don thag gcod par byed thabs gnyis yod pa ste/gcig ma rmos lo tog btab chog pa'i gzan chas kyi sa zhing du sngo nyar ma rmos lo tog mang 'debs bya dgos/ sngo nyar ma rmos lo tog de gsog nyar byed pa'i dus yud ring la/53

dgun thog dang dpyid thog ste sngo rtswa dkon pa'i skabs su lug gis lo rtswa las ljang ldem ldem gyi sngo nyar ma rmos lo tog zos na 'dod pa zhig yin/ lug gso ba'i khyim tshang gis rang yul gyi gzan chas zhing sar btab nas rang gnas su bed spyod byas na 'tsham mo/ /gnyis/ 'brog khul du dgun thog dang dpyid thog rtswa ha cang dkon pas/ rang gi sa cha nas gzan rtswa 'debs pa dang 'breg pa/ gsog nyar byed pa sogs byas na 'gro gron je dma' ru gtong thub pa yin/lnga ba/ lu gu dus thog tu btsong dgos /dgun kha bsleb la nye skabs grangs ka nges can gyi ma mo dang khrom lug skor zhig 'jog pa las/ btsong bya'i lu gu tshang ma btsong dgos/ lag len las ra sprod byas pa ltar na/ lu gu lo der gso skyong byas nas btsongs na khe phan zung gi nus pa mngon 'gyur bya thub nges yin/gcig lu gu lo der gso skyong byas nas btsongs na lug gso skyong gi btsong tshad dang tshong rdzas su 'gyur tshad je mthor 54

'gro thub la/ lu gu'i sha zhim pas rin gong kyang mtho/gnyis/ lu gu lo der gso skyong byas nas btsongs na /dgun dpyid kyi gzan chas dang lug ra'i dgos mkho yang je nyung du gtong thub pa red/lu gu snyor skyong byed tshul/gson tshad mtho zhing sha shed rgyas pa/ 'a/ga chags tshad mgyogs pa'i lu gu gso skyong bya na/ gsham gsal gyi byed thabs lag len bya dgos pa ste/gcig gsar btsas lu gur snga mo nas 'o spri nu ru 'jug dgos/gnyis/ ma med lu gu dang / sha shed zhan pa'i lu gu'am lu gu mtshe ma la mi'i thabs kyis nu ma bsnun dgos/gsum/ lug lhas gtsang sbra byas nas/ lu gu'i bshal nad sngon 'gog bya dgos/ lu gu btsas rjes gza' 'khor gcig gi nang du bshal nad ha cang 'byung sla bas/ dus der gtsang sbra la ha cang mnyam 'jog bya dgos pa dang / lhag par du mi'i thabs kyis nu ma snun pa'i lu gu la de bas kyang 55

legs shos ni sran ma dang / 'ba' cha/ ma rmos lo rtog so ba/gro shun/ 'bras shun sogs yin/ gzan chas legs shos nang du phye mar btags pa'i rtswa skam spus legs305nas405bsres na rtswa skam bed spyod byed tshad je mtho dang / lto zhu ba dang bcud len par phan par ma zad/ da dung gzan rtswa gron chung yang bya thub bo/ /sngo skam byas pa'i ma rmos lo tog gi gzhung rta dang / la ser/ gzan spyod mngar zas sogs kyang dgun dpyid du ma mor ster ba'i gzan chas legs shos yin/ dgun dpyid du ma mor bcud ldan gzan chas legs shos 'di dag byin tshe/ma mor mngar rigs dang 'tsho bcud sna mang 'don sprod bya thub pas ma mo'i 'o spri je mang du 'gro ba red/ lhag par du sbrum ldan ma mor zhogs pa dang nyin gung / dgong mo bcas thengs gsum la gzan chas ster dgos pa dang / dus mtshungs su gzan chas spus legs dang sngo rtswa skam po sogs zhogs pa dang nyin gung / dgong mo bcas thengs gsum la byin na ma mos 'tsho bcud bsdu len byed par phan pa yod/77

baba' lug byed pa'i lug rnga leb 'tsho skyong byed tshul/lug sha ni lug gso'i las rigs khrod kyi thon rdzas gtso bo zhig yin/ lug rgyud spel rgyur mi 'jog pa'i lug thug dang thong ba/ sha bzan/ rgyud spel nus pa shor ba'i ma mo sogs gsos te bsha' lug byas na 'os/ gsos 'u ga gi sha mang bas/yong sga'ang de bzhin du 'phar thub/dang po/ gsos lug gso ba'i byed thabs/gsos lug gso ba'i dmigs yul ni dus yun thung ngu'i nang mgyogs myur ngang lug la shed mong 'bud du 'jug pa dang / sha rgyu je legs su gtong ba/ pags pa legs po thon skyed byed pa bcas yin/de na sha dang tshil du 'gyur ba'i ma bcos rgyu cha gtso bo ni spri dkar dang tshil/ ten hphun sogs yin pas/ gzan chas kyis 'u ga gso skabs nges par du gzan chas spus legs cung mang bo ster dgos pa dang / gso lug gi 'ju byed sdud len byed tshad gzan chas spus legs kyis tshim par bya dgos/lug rnga leb gso bar ches 'tsham pa'i gzan chas ni sran 79

rigs dang / snum snyigs kyi rigs/ gro shun/ khre rgod/ ma rmos lo tog sogs yin/ lug gso mgo ma brtsams pa'i sngon gyi nyin10nas nyin15ni gra sgrig gi skabs yin la/ skabs der gzan rtswa'i grub cha rim bzhin brje spor byed pa dang / gzan chas ster ba'i byed thabs kyang tshad nyung thengs mang du bsgyur nas lug gi yi ga 'byed dgos/ der gnas tshul dngos la gzhigs nas nyin re'i gzan chas ster tshad gtan khel byas na legs/ 'dres sbyor gyi gzan chas khrod tshwa nyung tsam 'debs 'os/ sngo rtswa'i gzan chas dang sngo rtswa gsog nyar gzan chas byin na lug gi yi ga phye nas za tshad je mang du gtong thub/ lug gi gso yun ni 'tsho skyong gi chu tshad la bltas nas gtan khel bya dgos/ drod khang du lug gso na nyin75nas nyin100longs dgos/ gso yun thung drabs na phan 'bras mngon gsal mi 'byung ba dang / gso yun ring drags na gzan chas kyi 'gro gron che ba red/lug rnga leb gso bar chung lug gso tshul dang che lug gso tshul gnyis yod/ sha'i bza' tshad 'phar ba dang lug khyu 80

rgya bskyed pa dang bstun nas chung lug gso tshad rgya bskyed dgos/ gso lug che chung gang yin rung / lug la rgyun ldan du mkho ba'i 'tsho bcud las mang ba'i gzan chas ster dgos/de ltar byas na lug gi sha gnad dang tshil rgyas thub/ chung lug gsos na che lug gso ba las bzang ste/ rgyu mtshan ni chung lug gi sha shed rgyas pa che lug las mgyogs pas red/gnyis pa/ chung lug gso thabs/chung lug gi sha la bro ba ldan pa dang / sha gnag mang zhing tshil nyung ba/ sha snyi zhing khu ba mang ba/ lus kyi ljid tshad 'phar ba mgyogs pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan pas/dbyar ston gnyis kyi gzan rtswa'i thon khungs bed spyod byas nas ston gzhug bshas na/ gzan chas dang phyugs khang yang gron chung bya thub/ gron chung byas pa'i gzan chas dang phyugs khang bkol nas ma mo sbrum ma dang lug gzhan dag gsos na/ gcig go gnyis chod kyi yong sgo bskrun thub par ma zad/ gsos na ha cang ngo gsal ba zhig yin/lug rnga leb ni chung lug gsos te lug sha thon skyed byed 81

pa'i lug rgyud spus legs shig yin stabs / 'u ga rgyud 'di la sngar las mthong chen dang bed spyod legs po bya 'os/chung lug gso skabs/ nu ma nu mtshams bcad rjes gzan chas byin te mgyogs myur gyis cher skye dang sha shed rgyas su 'jug dgos/ zanas zla10can gyi chung lug gi ljid tshad ni spyi ༅0nas spyi ༅5yan la bsleb thub/ chung lug gso tshe lhas gso byas na cung bzang / de'i gzan chas la sran rigs dang sngo rtswa/ lo rtswa legs po las gzhan sngo rtswa gsog nyar byas pa sogs bzang /gsum pa/ che lug gso thabs/che lug gso tshul gtso bo ni 'dzin lug la mi 'jog pa'i pho lug dang mo lug la gzan chas byin nas sha shed rgyas su bcug rjes dus thog tu bsha' ba de red/ thabs 'di stabs bde zhing ma gnas kyang dma' bas/ phan 'bras cung bzang bo 'thob thub/thon skyed sa khul gyi mang tshogs la che lug gso ba'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa yod/ che lug gso na zhing zhor 82

thon rdzas dang gzan chas spus legs bed spyod byed pa gtso bo bya dgos/lug rnga leb ngo ma yin min brtag thabs/dang po/ lug rnga leb kyi khyad chos/lug rnga leb ngo ma yin na bongs tshad che zhing byad sna ring ba dang / rkang lag ring la sna gdong 'bur du thon pa zhig yin/ pho lug yin na rwa co dung dbyibs bzhin 'khyil ba dang / mo lug yin na rwa co chung chung can dang rwa co sga skya'i dbyibs can sogs yod la/ ha cang nyung shos shig la rwa co med/ pho lug gi mgo che zhing ske sbom pa dang / mo lug gi mgo chung zhing ske phra la/ tshil rnga de pus tshigs kyi gong la bslebs shing / lus kyi spu mdog dkar po yin/ pho lug yin na zla ba4'gor tshe spyi ༅5nas spyi ༅0la 'bud pa yin la/ mo lug yin na zla7'gor rjes spyi ༅skyinas spyi tso5la 'bud srid/ lo gcig la lu gu thengs2dang yang na lo1la lu gu thengs3btsa' ba yin/ btsa' thengs rer lu gucinas lu gu5btsa' srid/ches mang na lu ku7nasacibatsa' ba'i ma mo'ang yod/ pho lug kha 83

gang zhig gi gzugs kyi mtho tshad la lis smis100yod pa dang /ches mtho na lis smis110yod/ lus kyi ljid tshad la spyi rgya125yod cing / ches ljid na spyi rgya180la 'bud srid/ mo lug kha gang zhig gi gzugs kyi mtho tshad la lis smis84dang / lus kyi ljid tshad la spyi tso)yod cing / ches ljid na spyi rgya125la 'bud srid/gnyis pa/ lug rnga leb ngo ma yin min brtag thabs/gcig lug tshong rgyag mkhan 'ga' zhig gis dus rgyun lo gcig dang phyed ka can gyi hu'u yang lug dang lug rnga leb kyi lu gu gnyis rigs 'dra yin pa'i khyad chos bed spyad nas lug nyor mgo skor gtong bzhin yod/ don dngos su lug de gnyis la khyad par gsal bo yod/ hu'u yang lug la rwa co med/ lug rnga leb kyi pho lug la rwa co yod pa dang / mo lug phal cher la yang rwa co yod/ hu'u yang lug gi lus gzugs ni byad sna ring yang thong zheng chung ba dang / dpyi mgo cung mtho zhing yar skye 'tshar longs 'byung ba cung dal bar ma zad/che lug gi lus bongs kyang ha cang chung /84

gnyis/ sa cha la las de snga lug rnga leb la rgyud 'dres sdeb sbyor byas te/ lug rgyud 'dres ma skor zhig skyes yod/lug rgyud 'dres ma'i lug de dag gi gzugs dbyibs lug rnga leb dang phal cher 'dra na yang bongs tshad chung la yar skye 'byung tshad dal ba dang / lu gu btsa' tshad dma' bas dbye ba 'byed par do snang bya dgos so/ /lug rnga leb nang 'dren dang 'tsho skyong bdag gnyer byed tshul/lug rnga leb ni gzugs gzhi che zhing lag chags sla ba/'phel tshad mtho zhing sa lhag mi 'khur ba/ btsa' thengs mang zhing btsa' grangs mi nyung ba bcas kyi khyad chos dang ldan pas/kun la khyab gdal du gtong rin yod pa'i lug rgyud bzang bo zhig yin/ 1990lo nas bzung lug rnga leb ni rang rgyal nub rgyud sa khul du spel mgo brtsams pa dang / 2000lo nas2002lor lug rnga leb spel ba'i sgang la bslebs byung /dang po/ lug rnga leb kyi khyad chos/lug rnga leb kyi khyab yul gtso bo ni hran tung zhing chen 85

dang hi pe zhing chen/ nang sog rang skyong ljongs bcas yin la/lug rgyud de'i bal kha dkar yang bal rkang gcig mtshungs min/ bal gyi nang du 'khyar rtsub nyung tsam yod la/ bal mgo dang bal rting la khra thig yod/ lug rgyud de'i bal dang pags pa ltar na tsha ru'i rigs dang bal 'jam gyi rigs/ bal rtsub kyi rigs te rigs gsum du dbye chog tsha ru'i rigs kyi bal rkang 'khyil te bal kha la 'jil li yod pa dang / bal 'jam rigs kyi bal rkang phra zhing bal kha'i 'jil li chung ba dang /bal rtsub rigs kyi bal rkang sbom pa dang 'jil li yang che ba yin/lug rnga leb kyi gzugs gzhi do mnyam pa dang logs zur nas bltas na gling bzhi zhig yin la/ gdong 'bur zhing rna thur du dpyangs 'dug tshil rkyang can gyi rnga ma sgor dbyibs yin la rnga rtse yar 'khyil cing / rnga ma'i ring tshad pus mtshams la bslebs 'dug brang gzhung che zhing rtsib rus mthar chod pa dang / sgal gzhung drang zhing mnyam pa zhig yin/byad sna ring zhing zo dbyibs dang mtshungs la/ sug bzhi ring 86

zhing drang mo yin/ khrom gyi mgo bo che zhing ske sbom la/ dung 'khyil lta bu'i rwa co chen po yod/ ma mo'i mgo chung zhing ske ring ba dang rwa co chung chung re yod la/ rwa co med pa'ang yod/lag chags pa mgyogs shing chags pa lang tshad snga/ le'igam lo'agor ba'i lag mor chags pa yod pa dang / 'phel tshad ha cang mtho/ ma mo ni nam yin yang chags pa lang ba zhig yin pas/ lo1re'i nang du lu gu theng4la btsa' ba dang /btsa' thengs rer lu gu2nas lu nyu3btsa' ba cung mang / zacan gyi lag ga zhig gi ljid tshad ni spyi gyo20yas mas dang /lag mo'i ljid tshad spyi rgya18yas mas yin/gnyis pa/ lug rgyud nang 'dren byed skabs gyi mnyam 'jog sa 'ga'/gcig bden rdzun dbye 'byed byed pa/ lug rnga leb la phyi'i khyad chos mngon gsal zhig yod na'ang / lug rgyud 'di nyo mkhan gyis lug rgyud rnam dag yin min la zhib tu brtag dgos/ de min phyin lug btsong mkhan la las lug rgyud rnam dag min pa'i lug btsong ba'i gnas tshul ni nam yang 'byung 87

bzhin yod pas/ lug rgyud brtag ma shes na g.yo 'og tu tshud de dpal 'byor gyi gyong gud thebs nyen che'o/ /gnyis/ nad yams brtag zhib byed pa'i 'gag sgo lhod mi rung / nad yams 'gog bcos ni gso gnyer khe las bde thang dang gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i gnad 'gag gal chen zhig yin pas na/ lug rgyud 'dren mkhan gyis nad yams gtan 'gog byed pa'i ched du sa gnas rang gi nad yams brtag zhib sde khag la yar zhu byas te/ nyos lug thams cad la brtag zhib byas shing nad yams khyer yong ba gtan 'gog bya dgos/ rab yin na rna rtags yod pa'i lug nyo dgos/gsum/ lug rin 'os 'tsham yin dgos/ tshong rdzas gang zhig yin yang der 'os 'bab kyi rin gong zhig yod nges/lug rnga leb kyi thon khungs gtso bo ste hran tung zhing chen gyi leng hran rdzong gi lug gso ba'i khyim tshang re na lug rnga leb bcu re gsos yod/ sa cha zhig gi lug rgyud bzang bo zhig la mtshon na lug rer 'os 'bab kyi rin gong re yod na 'grig mod/ 'on kyang lug rnga leb kyi rin gong ni lug rang gi rin 88

gong las tshad las brgal drags song / lo rabs90ba'i mgo la lug rnga leb thon sa'i che lug re'i lug gong ni sgor mo1000yan yin la/ da lta zhang thog nas zla'inas lobar gyi mo lug cig nyos na sgor mo400nas sgor mo600ster dgos pa dang /zla7nas zla6can gyi lag ga zhig nyos na sgor mo1000nas sgor mo1300ster dgos/ de bas lug nyo mkhan gyis lug ma nyos gong la lug gi rin gong dang lug gi tshong rar bsam blo zhib mo zhig gtong dgos/ de min phyin dgos med kyi dpal 'byor gyong gud nyo srid/gsum pa/ gso skyong bdag gnyer byed par mnyam 'jog dgos sa 'ga'/gcig rgya che mi rung / lug rnga leb la lu gu mang bo 'khrid pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pas/ lug rnga leb gso rgya che na lug khang du mngal sbrum yod pa'i ma mo 'tshang kha rgyag srid/'tshang kha brgyab na ma mo'i mngal shor ba dang / yang na ma mo sbrum ma shi ba'i nyen kha yod do/ /gnyis/ gzan chas ma nga bo gra sgrig dang gzan chas ster 89

bar lag thogs mi dgos pa zhig bya dgos/ lug rnga leb kyis lu gu mang bo btsa' srid pas/ ma/ mo sbrum ma la zas bcud phun sum tshogs pa mkho sprod bya dgos/ de bas lug rnga leb ni khang ba'i nang du gso skyong bya dgos pa dang / gzan chas phun sum tshogs pa gra sgrig byas te tshan rig gi sgo nas las snon byed pa dang mnyam du gzan chas kyi nang du gzan chas spus legs nges can zhig bsre dgos/ de ltar byas na ma mo sbrum ma la 'tsho bcud phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ mngal du sbrum yod pa'i phru gu bde thang ngang 'tshar longs 'byung ba khag theg bya thub/gsum/ zhib tshags yod pa'i sgo nas/ khrom lug gso skyong bdag gnyer bya dgos/ rang byung 'khrig spyod la brten nas mngal 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / yang na mi'i lag thabs la brten nas mngal 'dzin du 'jug na khrom lug gi byed nus la gtan nas mthong chung byed mi rung / der brten/ khrom lug gso skyong bdag gnyer byed pa'i bya ba dam 'dzin bya dgos/dgos mkho yod na khrom lug la gzan chas kha snon byed pa 90

dang mnyam du 'gul skyod byed du bcug nas/ nam yin yang 'khrig pa spyod thub pa'i chags pa ldan du 'jug dgos par ma zad/ lo re nang du gzhan gyi khrom lug dang brjes te nye rgyud skye 'phel byed pa bkag sdom bya dgos/bzhi/ sdeb sbyor legs bsgyur/ cha rkyen yod sa nas lug rnga leb kyi gzugs gzhi che ba dang / lu gu btsa' grangs mang ba/ dus bzhir chags pa lang ba sogs kyi yon tan bed spyad de sha spyod lug rgyud de rwa med tha'o sa'e thi sogs kyi khrom lug dang sdeb sbyor legs bsgyur byed pa dang / sdeb sbyor byas pa'i lug rgyud kyi steng la ma rgyud kyi lag chags sla ba dang dus bzhir chags pa lang ba/ lu gu btsa' grangs mang ba sogs kyi khyad chos dang pha rgyud kyi lag chags sla ba dang sha yi thon tshad mtho ba sogs kyi khyad chos 'dzom du bcug ste/ ches mtho ba'i lug gso ba'i dpal 'byor yong sgo bskrun dgos/sgo zog la sman ldud skabs kha 'dzi dgos/sgo zog la sman ldud skabs gzan chas dang bsre rdzas kyi thad nas kha ma 'dzi na sman nus yag ngo zhig thon mi thub/91

der brten/ sgo zog la sman ldud skabs gzan chas sam bsre rdzas kyi thad nas kha 'dzi na/ sman nus thon par phan no/ /dang po/ tshwa khu/tshwa khus zhug rdzas 'dres pa'i sman sna rdzing lud las phyir 'bud du 'jug pa yin pas/ zhug rdzas 'dres pa'i sman ldud skabs tshwa khu ster mi rung bar ma zad/ mkhal nad sman bcos byed skabs kyang tshwa khu ster mi rung /gnyis pa/ bro tshal/rpā tshal gyi nang du rtswa skyur 'dres pas/ 'ju byed ma lag gi nang gi gī rdzas dang phrad tshe 'ju mi thub pa'i rtswa skyur du gyur te/ phung gzugs kyis gī bcud len par gnod pa byed srid/ gī rdzas med pa'i nad zog la gī rdzas kyis sman bcos byed skabs rpā tshal kha 'dzi dgos/gsum pa/ sran rigs/sran ser dang sran nag gi nang du rmā rdzas dang gī rdzas/lcags rdzas sogs 'dres pa dang / rdzas sna de dag si hon su'u dang phrad na 'ju dka' ba'i dngos rdzas su 'gyur srid/si hon su'u yis nad zog sman bcos byed skabs sran ser 92

dang sran nag kha 'dzi dgos/bzhi ba/ phub ma/phub ma'i nang du lin rdzas mang zhing gī rdzas nyung bas na/rus snyi'i nad dang rdzing las rde'u 'khyongs pa/ rgyu ma las rde'u 'khyongs pa'i nad sogs 'gog bcos byed skabs phub ma kha 'dzi dgos/ lig son ya the dang cu'u yon the an gyis khrag zhan pa'i nad zog sman bcos byed skabs kyang phub ma kha 'dzi dgos/93
